facts.business: Rama Petrochemicals Limited is engaged in the petrochemicals business and has a wholly owned subsidiary, Rama Capital and Fiscal Services Private Limited, engaged in financial services.

auditor.name: M/s. Ashok Patel & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company treated payment of Rs.18,500 thousand towards release of collateral securities as 'Other Financial Assets' which is not in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. Retained Earnings and Current Assets are higher as on 31st March, 2026 by Rs 18,500 thousand.

key_risks: Related party transactions pose significant financial reporting risk due to the possibility of transactions being conducted at prices deviating from the arm's length principle.
facts.related_party_note: The sale to related parties are made on terms equivalent to those that prevail in arm's length transactions. Outstanding balances at the year end are unsecured and settlement occurs in cash. Significant transactions include loans/advances taken and repaid with Rama Industries Ltd (Rs 242,200 thousand taken, Rs 196,000 thousand repaid in 2026), Rainbow Agri Industries Ltd, and Bluelagoon Investments Pvt Ltd.
